creator: Kyro

hero.ability1: Guided Hand: Once during each of your turns, if you draw a minion, reveal it, and then draw another card.
hero.ability2: Reanimate: If at the start of your turn you controlled less minions than your opponent, you can spend 2 lifeforce to resurrect a minion from your graveyard that costs 3 or less.
hero.ability3: Press the Advantage: If at the start of your turn you controlled more minions than your opponent, you can spend 2 lifeforce to increase the attack of all of your minions by 1 until the end of the turn.
hero.ability4: Corpse Explosion: Once during each of your turns, you may spend 2 lifeforce to destroy a minion you control then deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.

card.effects: During your turn, when this Weapon attacks, it takes no damage in return. When your Hero inflicts damage with this Weapon, you may inflict 1 damage to up to two Targets.

notes: The goal of this deck is to fill your graveyard with your 3 cost minions and use reanimate as many times as possible every turn. The deck has a high minion count for consistent extra draws from Guided Hand. You want to use Sacrifice card on your 3 and 2 cost minions as much as possible in order to gain lifeforce and be able to reanimate those.minions at a discount.
